name: tz-extension
description: Browser extension for timezone conversion: select-to-convert, full converter, epoch converter.

scripts.build:firefox: tsc --noEmit && TARGET=firefox vite build && node scripts/firefox-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.zip:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd dist && rm -f ../tz-extension-chrome.zip && zip -r -X ../tz-extension-chrome.zip . -x '.*' '*.map' '.vite/*'
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist-firefox && rm -f ../tz-extension-firefox.zip && zip -r -X ../tz-extension-firefox.zip . -x '.*' '*.map' '.vite/*'
scripts.zip:all: npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox
